customer_message.subject: Mould, cold bedrooms and request for expert – Allmendstrasse 53
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We rent a 5.5-room flat at Allmendstrasse 53 in Muttenz from Domicil Plus Immobilien AG.

The bathroom ceiling has grey-green mould on it, which keeps coming back after we clean it, and there is a musty smell in the hallway that you notice as soon as you come in. On top of that, we wake up to cold bedrooms most mornings; the boiler has an error light on almost every morning, and the radiators upstairs are only lukewarm by breakfast.

Domicil Plus says the mould is our fault. We think something in the building is wrong, perhaps the bathroom extraction or the roof. Since nobody agrees on the cause, an independent building expert has to inspect the flat; I have asked Domicil Plus to commission one, and they refused.

I should mention that my husband has been coughing for some weeks. We have not found out whether it is connected with the flat or whether it is just a stubborn cold going round his office.

What can we do to get the mould examined properly and the problems fixed?

Kind regards,
Nadia Ortega
